sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A bachelor-level applicant can apply to the PhD route; this is not an assessment of competitiveness. Complete
UChicago degree before enrollment. No terminal mathematics master’s application is listed. F-1 status is not
an academic qualification. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare transcripts, CV, two statements and three referees. Obtain institution certification of English-medium
instruction if the transcript does not say this. Register referees early; request any fee waiver before paying. [s1]
[s6] [s7] [s8]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
No pre-application supervisor agreement was established. Faculty below are research-fit leads; current
admissions capacity should be asked directly and cannot be inferred from papers. [s1] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use central Prepare pages and application checklist; both statements can be revised before deadline, and
references tracked online. [s4] [s5] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 application open; precise 2026 deadline confirmed centrally and in program listing. 2027-28 stipend
not established. [s2] [s3] [s9]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
15 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time: application and all required supporting materials. No late
applications. [s2]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics funding deadline identified in reviewed admissions pages; confirm whether any
external fellowship has an independent application. Do not infer that all outside awards share 15 December.
[s1] [s3]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Submit any required English score at least three weeks before the program deadline (24 November 2026 is the
calculated planning date). Later scores can be matched but no admission offer without required scores. GRE is
optional; no distinct late-score grace period verified. [s7] [s2]

Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established from the public sources reviewed. Verify in the current application or with graduate admissions
before relying on this item.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL, IELTS or DET for applicants not meeting an exemption. Acceptance of a new TOEFL scale is discussed
on the central page; do not use an old score threshold without checking that page. [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago English-taught undergraduate degree qualifies if awarded before Princeton enrollment. Transcript
must state English instruction or include an institutional letter/certificate in the same transcript upload. No
separate waiver request required. [s7]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Optional/not required. [s1] [s3]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional/not required in the central program listing, but highly recommended by the mathematics department.
These are compatible: allowed and encouraged, not mandatory. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three; extra letters may or may not be considered. English letters from people familiar with academic work.
[s1] [s6]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference/application was established from the reviewed public
application checklist. External awards require their own checks. [s1]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Register recommender email in the application; the recommender receives electronic submission instructions.
Registration can occur before final application submission. [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations are not restricted to after submission. You may submit while letters are pending, but letters still
have the supporting-material deadline. [s6] [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Portal shows not started/sent, in progress, or submitted; reminders available before and after submission. [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Prior-cycle letters do not carry forward. Once the request is received, the recommender cannot be
changed/removed; FERPA choice is locked. A recommender letter-service address may be used. Replacement
of an already submitted letter is not documented. [s6]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required CV/resume upload. Specific page limit and file formatting not stated on the departmental checklist;
inspect central CV/upload instructions. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required uploaded essay, English, maximum 1,000 words; no prescribed formatting. Prompt paraphrase:
explain Princeton fit, graduate-study goals, academic and career plans, and relevant formative
academic/professional experiences. Corrected version may be uploaded through checklist before deadline
only. [s4]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required uploaded essay, English, maximum 250 words; no prescribed formatting. Prompt paraphrase:
describe an experience influencing graduate study and how lessons learned would enrich the residential
scholarly community. Revision allowed before deadline only. [s5]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Address academic plans and program fit within academic statement; a separate research-interest document is
not specified in the departmental list. Separate prompt/limit not verified. [s4] [s1]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Course-list
document; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]

upload is permitted; check current program supplement for prompt, limits and upload/link rules. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Published 2026-27 university rates, NOT a 2027-28 math offer: University Fellowship USD 52,680/12 months;
first-year natural sciences fellowship USD 46,200/10 months; RA USD 46,200/10 months plus summer RA USD
9,240/2 months; TA USD 48,510/10 months. Tuition USD 65,210 and health-plan fee USD 4,220 are charges,
not cash stipend. Which rate/combination applies to incoming mathematics needs confirmation. [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full funding guaranteed during regular PhD enrollment; mathematics program catalog gives four-year length.
Any fifth-year support must be confirmed in offer or extension policy. [s11] [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Central guarantee covers all degree-seeking PhD candidates during regular enrollment, without a nationality
exception on this policy. Inference: international mathematics admit is included; external awards can have
separate citizenship restrictions. [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Regular degree enrollment and the applicable department support terms; specific satisfactory-progress,
summer and teaching details should be read in offer. [s11] [s9]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference/application was established from the reviewed public
application checklist. External awards require their own checks. [s1]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
University fellowships, teaching/research assistantships, external fellowships and dissertation-completion
funding exist; external-award eligibility and deadlines are separate. [s11]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 90, nonrefundable, paid in portal. [s8]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Financial hardship, eligible program participation, qualifying recruitment event/workshop. Request inside
application at least two business days before departmental deadline; decisions usually 2-3 business days. Do
not pay until decision; if denied pay by application deadline. UChicago REU does not automatically prove
NSF-REU eligibility. [s8]

Princeton University
United States · Mathematics PhD
2026 US News roster/rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• English degree exemption needs transcript wording or an institutional certificate, not simply attendance at a
US university.
• Math GRE is optional but highly recommended.
• Current faculty roster includes people omitted from the older research-area page.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A bachelor-level applicant can apply to the PhD route; this is not an assessment of competitiveness. Complete
UChicago degree before enrollment. No terminal mathematics master’s application is listed. F-1 status is not
an academic qualification. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare transcripts, CV, two statements and three referees. Obtain institution certification of English-medium
instruction if the transcript does not say this. Register referees early; request any fee waiver before paying. [s1]
[s6] [s7] [s8]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
No pre-application supervisor agreement was established. Faculty below are research-fit leads; current
admissions capacity should be asked directly and cannot be inferred from papers. [s1] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use central Prepare pages and application checklist; both statements can be revised before deadline, and
references tracked online. [s4] [s5] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 application open; precise 2026 deadline confirmed centrally and in program listing. 2027-28 stipend
not established. [s2] [s3] [s9]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
15 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time: application and all required supporting materials. No late
applications. [s2]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics funding deadline identified in reviewed admissions pages; confirm whether any
external fellowship has an independent application. Do not infer that all outside awards share 15 December.
[s1] [s3]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Submit any required English score at least three weeks before the program deadline (24 November 2026 is the
calculated planning date). Later scores can be matched but no admission offer without required scores. GRE is
optional; no distinct late-score grace period verified. [s7] [s2]

Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established from the public sources reviewed. Verify in the current application or with graduate admissions
before relying on this item.
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL, IELTS or DET for applicants not meeting an exemption. Acceptance of a new TOEFL scale is discussed
on the central page; do not use an old score threshold without checking that page. [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago English-taught undergraduate degree qualifies if awarded before Princeton enrollment. Transcript
must state English instruction or include an institutional letter/certificate in the same transcript upload. No
separate waiver request required. [s7]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Optional/not required. [s1] [s3]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional/not required in the central program listing, but highly recommended by the mathematics department.
These are compatible: allowed and encouraged, not mandatory. [s1] [s3]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload a transcript from each college/university where a degree was earned or is expected. Unofficial
transcript acceptable at application; mailed transcripts not accepted. [s1]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics checklist. This is not proof that an optional
upload is permitted; check current program supplement for prompt, limits and upload/link rules. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three; extra letters may or may not be considered. English letters from people familiar with academic work.
[s1] [s6]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference/application was established from the reviewed public
application checklist. External awards require their own checks. [s1]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Register recommender email in the application; the recommender receives electronic submission instructions.
Registration can occur before final application submission. [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations are not restricted to after submission. You may submit while letters are pending, but letters still
have the supporting-material deadline. [s6] [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Portal shows not started/sent, in progress, or submitted; reminders available before and after submission. [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Prior-cycle letters do not carry forward. Once the request is received, the recommender cannot be
changed/removed; FERPA choice is locked. A recommender letter-service address may be used. Replacement
of an already submitted letter is not documented. [s6]

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required CV/resume upload. Specific page limit and file formatting not stated on the departmental checklist;
inspect central CV/upload instructions. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required uploaded essay, English, maximum 1,000 words; no prescribed formatting. Prompt paraphrase:
explain Princeton fit, graduate-study goals, academic and career plans, and relevant formative
academic/professional experiences. Corrected version may be uploaded through checklist before deadline
only. [s4]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required uploaded essay, English, maximum 250 words; no prescribed formatting. Prompt paraphrase:
describe an experience influencing graduate study and how lessons learned would enrich the residential
scholarly community. Revision allowed before deadline only. [s5]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Address academic plans and program fit within academic statement; a separate research-interest document is
not specified in the departmental list. Separate prompt/limit not verified. [s4] [s1]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Course-list
document; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics checklist. This is not proof that an optional
upload is permitted; check current program supplement for prompt, limits and upload/link rules. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference/application was established from the reviewed public
application checklist. External awards require their own checks. [s1]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Published 2026-27 university rates, NOT a 2027-28 math offer: University Fellowship USD 52,680/12 months;
first-year natural sciences fellowship USD 46,200/10 months; RA USD 46,200/10 months plus summer RA USD
9,240/2 months; TA USD 48,510/10 months. Tuition USD 65,210 and health-plan fee USD 4,220 are charges,
not cash stipend. Which rate/combination applies to incoming mathematics needs confirmation. [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full funding guaranteed during regular PhD enrollment; mathematics program catalog gives four-year length.
Any fifth-year support must be confirmed in offer or extension policy. [s11] [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Central guarantee covers all degree-seeking PhD candidates during regular enrollment, without a nationality
exception on this policy. Inference: international mathematics admit is included; external awards can have
separate citizenship restrictions. [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Regular degree enrollment and the applicable department support terms; specific satisfactory-progress,
summer and teaching details should be read in offer. [s11] [s9]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference/application was established from the reviewed public
application checklist. External awards require their own checks. [s1]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
University fellowships, teaching/research assistantships, external fellowships and dissertation-completion
funding exist; external-award eligibility and deadlines are separate. [s11]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 90, nonrefundable, paid in portal. [s8]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Financial hardship, eligible program participation, qualifying recruitment event/workshop. Request inside
application at least two business days before departmental deadline; decisions usually 2-3 business days. Do
not pay until decision; if denied pay by application deadline. UChicago REU does not automatically prove
NSF-REU eligibility. [s8]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Standing rule]
GRE central listing says optional while department highly recommends subject test; retain both. Old
faculty-research area page is incomplete/stale relative to current people directory, so current roster was
preferred. [s1] [s3] [s10]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm funding guarantee, 2027-28 stipend and summer support, commitment deadline, any supplemental
course-list/upload fields, and already-submitted letter replacement. Obtain English-medium certificate; verify
any REU-based waiver eligibility. [s1] [s7] [s9]
